title: Fix this app
body: Been using this app for years and in recent times it has become so deeply flawed its almost unusable. Typing at a normal speed seems too hard for the buffer to keep up with, which creates constant typos and even occasionally a bug where the whole keyboard goes blank and locks up. I did some reading and discovered apparently this is because the app has been setup to frequently cloud backup what I’m typing. This has created an extraordinarily clunky word processing experience, not at all capable of keeping up with my train of thought as I type and ultimately disruptive to my concentration. Dear god fix this app…
